criteria.name: Correct focal event and work stage
Initial uncertainty and no unsupported personal blame
Questions target topology, timing and document applicability
Join pressure values to measurement locations
Separate alarm meaning, trip claim and acknowledgment time
Request missing discriminator without premature mechanism
Identify the two series valves and complete-path requirement
Connect both unavailable paths to receiving-pressure loss
Use restoration with unchanged main valve as corroboration
Respect observation timing and inspection scope
Identify installed configuration versus actually issued instruction
Identify specific change-routing gap without invented motive
Resolve early compressor-trip claim using later evidence
Evidence-driven board continuity, correction and clear labels
Mechanism-linked actions, effectiveness check and bounded stopping
